subject: Animation
title: The Hunchback's Dark Ambition
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Hunchback's Dark Ambition.

hook.text: Disney adapted Victor Hugo's dark novel about a deformed bell-ringer in Notre Dame cathedral.

buildup.text: The film featured arguably the darkest Disney villain: Frollo, driven by religious hypocrisy.

discovery.text: The sequence Hellfire depicted Frollo's inner torment with startling intensity for Disney.

twist.text: Gargoyle sidekicks and comic relief clashed with the dark themes, dividing audiences and critics.

climax.text: Hunchback showed that Disney's formula struggled when the source material resisted simplification.

punchline.text: Disney's boldest story could not survive its own formula.

quiz.question: What creative challenge did The Hunchback of Notre Dame face?
options: Its dark source material clashed with Disney's formula of comic sidekicks and light moments
